title: Energy Schema
description: Defines energy flow, dissipation, resonance amplitude, and stability structures for the Resonance Substrate Model (RSM). Supports energy-based operators, resonance envelopes, and cross-layer coupling.

energy_field.description: Represents the local energy state of the substrate.

value.description: Energy magnitude at a given point.

gradient.description: Spatial gradient of the energy field.

units.description: Optional unit system (e.g., joules, arbitrary units).

resonance_amplitude.description: Defines the amplitude of resonance within the energy layer.

stability.description: Defines stability constraints for energy evolution.

max_energy.description: Upper bound for stable energy evolution.

min_energy.description: Lower bound for stable energy evolution.

stabilization_operator.description: Name of the stabilization operator applied.

coupling.description: Energy coupling to other substrate fields.

scalar_coupling.description: Coupling strength to the scalar field.

vector_coupling.description: Coupling strength to the vector/spin field.

resonance_coupling.description: Coupling strength to the resonance envelope.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for documentation, provenance, or schema evolution.
